premises_consumed.scope: for a physical cross block M with Z=e_3(M^TM), row volume-sampling marginals <=1/2 imply ||p_Q||_infty<=6*sqrt(e)*Z^(-1/6); no column-side marginal restriction
residual Parseval frame with maximum leverage <=1/18 admits a two-block partition with both block Gram operators >=c_delta I, c_delta=1/2-sqrt(2delta)-delta

new_results.statement: In the exact-rank-three Schur-isotropic branch with spectral scale s and residual max leverage delta<=1/18, ||p_Q||_infty <= [6 sqrt(e)/(s c_delta)](1+r^2)^(1/6), c_delta=1/2-sqrt(2delta)-delta; in particular <=54 sqrt(e) s^-1 (1+r^2)^(1/6).

For normalized exact-spectrum Schur-isotropic packets, every physical cross-volume cut containing the hub has Z<= (1+r^2)^-1 and every residual-only cut has Z<=(1+r^2)^-2; therefore the e5f Theorem-D certificate 6 sqrt(e) Z^-1/6 cannot be shear-uniform through any single cut. This is not a lower bound on true density and not a QFORM counterexample.

stress_test.statement: For the circular Parseval frame v_j=(m^-1/2,sqrt(2/m)cos(2pi j/m),sqrt(2/m)sin(2pi j/m)), delta=3/m, so m>=54 yields ||p_Q||_infty<=54 sqrt(e)(1+r^2)^(1/6) for the normalized exact spectrum {-1,1,1}; exact two-plane extraction still degenerates as m grows.

unresolved_implication.statement: Use the full residual Pluecker identity sum_{i<j}det(n,v_i,v_j)^2=1 to build an original-coordinate/product-preserving asymmetric 1+2 estimate retaining scale comparable to r^2|det D|; this must avoid a single 3-volume cut and must occur before conditioning destroys product provenance.
